WATERFRONT LEAD (up): measured on imagery at 43.4465,-95.3275. The main row of about 8 rigs sits 35-85 m from the shore; two or three pads on the west side of the gravel area are only ~20-25 m from the water, with a belt of trees between and no road or trail I can see in between (the gravel lane to the dock runs north of them, a home's lot lies south). No campsite photos on the city's page to settle a filtered view. At 20-25 m through a thin tree belt from a few sites, I read this as `lakeview` at least; on-water would need the belt confirmed open. Old evidence 'continuous shoreline treeline (no on-water pads confirmed)' is right about the trees but gives no view call.

NOT IN DB: the same city page lists a second campground, South Shore Campground, 50 Country Club Drive, Lake Park ($25 with 30-amp, $10 no hookups; $100 week/$200 month; central water; restrooms; tent sites; same hosts). Lead: https://lakeparkia.com/explore/camping. Imagery shows a strip of rigs on the south shore about 43.4326,-95.3403; no DB entry within reach. Name the entry 'Silver Lake City Park - East' vs the city's 'Silver Lake City Park Campground'; the 'East' is ours.
Pin: on the pads (within ~30 m of the row). Stored 8 sites, 6 pull-throughs and 35 ft are not on the city's current page; imagery shows ~10-12 rigs.
